sources.title: Matrix-Game: Interactive World Foundation Model
sources.snippet: Matrix-Game adopts an image-to-world generation paradigm, using a single reference image as the primary prior for world understanding and video generation. To enable long-duration video generation, Matrix-Game uses an autoregressive strategy that preserves local temporal consistency across segments, enabling the model to maintain coherent dynamics over extended time horizons.
